source.enumeration_basis: Every line of source/codigo-penal-1940.txt that opens an article ('Art. N', 'Art N', 'Art. N-X', 'Art. N-X-Y', revoked ones included), restricted to this part: Parte Especial Título XI Caps. I, II and II-A, arts. 312–337-D (crimes de funcionário, de particular, contra a administração estrangeira). Generated mechanically by the conductor; units are articles.
source.enumeration_note: ONE PART (g6a) of twelve; registers/merge-parts.py merges them into registers/encoding-roadmap.json, whose enumeration is complete (434 units, every article number 1–361).

units.title: Peculato
units.note: Caput and § 1º (intentional: consummated and attempted), § 2º (culpable), § 3º (effect of repairing the damage, with the same-day case refused, F-g6a-08), penas of caput, § 1º (the caput's) and § 2º. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Forks F-g6a-06, -07, -08. As enacted in 1940; answers for any date. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Peculato mediante erro de outrem
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. The agent is read under Capítulo I's heading (F-g6a-04). As enacted in 1940. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Inserção de dados falsos em sistema de informações
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Added by Lei nº 9.983/2000: not a crime before 15.10.2000, refused on 15.10.2000, in force from 16.10.2000 (S-sweep-c-15; F-g6a-22). Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Modificação ou alteração não autorizada de sistema de informações
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, the parágrafo único's increase (1/3 to 1/2; whether it reaches the fine is F-g6a-09), causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Added by Lei nº 9.983/2000 (gate as art. 313-A). Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4. [g6a corrected this unit's title: the enumeration had taken the line before the article, 'Pena – reclusão, de 2 (dois) a 12 (doze) anos, e multa. (Incluído pela Lei nº 9.983, de 2000)'.]

units.title: Extravio, sonegação ou inutilização de livro ou documento
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena (no fine), causes; 'se o fato não constitui crime mais grave' as the judge's finding (F-g6a-10). The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Emprego irregular de verbas ou rendas públicas
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena ('ou multa'), causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. F-g6a-04. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Concussão
units.note: Caput (concussão), § 1º (excesso de exação), § 2º (qualified), each with its pena; several forms at once take the heaviest (F-g0-18). 'antes de assumi-la' reaches one not yet an official (F-g6a-11). The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Temporal scope: caput's pena re-written by Lei nº 13.964/2019 (in force 23.1.2020) — refused for an earlier fact, definition answers for any date; § 1º re-written whole by Lei nº 8.137/1990 (28.12.1990) — refused before. Tests in cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4.

units.title: Corrupção passiva
units.note: Caput (consummated and attempted), § 1º's increase, § 2º (privileged, no attempt), penas. 'antes de assumi-la' (F-g6a-11). The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Caput's pena re-written by Lei nº 10.763/2003 (in force 13.11.2003): refused for an earlier fact. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Facilitação de contrabando ou descaminho
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, causes; '(art. 334)' read as reaching art. 334-A's contrabando (F-g6a-12). The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Pena re-written by Lei nº 8.137/1990 (28.12.1990): refused before. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Prevaricação
units.note: Crime (no attempt, F-g6a-05), pena, causes. V33 / M-sweep-c-02: fork F-sweep-c-01 taken as `tipoOrdinario` (ADPF 881 pending); the ADPF 881 fact is carried and deliberately not read. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: (sem rubrica no texto compilado)
units.note: Crime (an omission; no attempt), pena (no fine), causes. 'Diretor de Penitenciária e/ou agente público' read as a funcionário (F-g6a-04). The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Added by Lei nº 11.466/2007 (in force 29.3.2007): not a crime before. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4. [g6a corrected this unit's title: the enumeration had taken the line before the article, 'Pena - detenção, de três meses a um ano, e multa.'.]

units.title: Condescendência criminosa
units.note: Crime (both limbs, turning on the official's competence; no attempt), pena, causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Advocacia administrativa
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único (illegitimate interest, 'além da multa' = cumulative), crime (consummated and attempted), penas, causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Violência arbitrária
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena with the violence's penalty besides, causes. Whether art. 322 survives the abuse-of-authority statutes is F-g6a-13 (encoded as printed). The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Abandono de função
units.note: Caput, § 1º (public harm), § 2º (border strip), penas; both paragraphs take the heavier. 'cargo público' as a fact (F-g6a-14). No attempt. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Exercício funcional ilegalmente antecipado ou prolongado
units.note: Both conducts, crime (consummated and attempted), pena, causes. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Violação de sigilo funcional
units.note: Caput, § 1º I-II and § 2º (damage), penas; subsidiarity as the judge's finding, reaching § 1º and not § 2º (F-g6a-10). The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. §§ 1º-2º added by Lei nº 9.983/2000 (gate as art. 313-A). Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Violação do sigilo de proposta de concorrência
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, causes. Encoded as printed; its overlap with art. 337-J (Lei nº 14.133/2021, g6b) is F-g6a-15. The agent is a funcionário público under art. 327 on the day of the act (`cp-g6a-comum.l4`); art. 327 § 2º's increase applies. Tests in cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4.

units.title: Funcionário público
units.note: Caput and § 1º (`funcionário público para os efeitos penais (art. 327)`, exported; equiparação reaches the one acted on too, F-g6a-01; § 1º, both limbs, refused by name before Lei nº 9.983/2000's vigência and on its uncertain day 15.10.2000, by the conductor's ruling, F-g6a-23 and F-g6a-22) and § 2º (the increase of one third, over a PROPOSTO-COMUM enumeration of bodies that encodes the paragraph's closed list — an autarquia is not in it, F-g6a-02; reach F-g6a-03). g2b, g5 and g6b call the exported rule since integration (2026-09-30). Tested through cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4 and the other test modules.

units.title: Usurpação de função pública
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único (advantage gained), crime (consummated and attempted), penas. Tests in cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4.

units.title: Resistência
units.note: Caput, § 1º (act not carried out), § 2º (the violence's penalty besides, article-wide, F-g6a-16), crime (consummated and attempted), penas. The one acted on is a funcionário under art. 327 (equiparação included, F-g6a-01) or his helper. Tests in cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4.

units.title: Desobediência
units.note: Crime (no attempt), pena. M-sweep-c-22 / F-sweep-c-14 (STJ Tema 1060) settled: an order to stop in ostensive policing is such an order; the fact is carried and deliberately not read. Tests in cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4.

units.title: Desacato
units.note: Crime (no attempt), pena. M-sweep-c-05 / F-sweep-c-02: ADPF 496's 'casos graves e evidentes de menosprezo à função pública' as the judge's finding. Tests in cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4.

units.title: Tráfico de Influência
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, the parágrafo único's increase of one half. Re-written whole by Lei nº 9.127/1995 (in force 17.11.1995): an earlier fact is refused. Tests in cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4.

units.title: Corrupção ativa
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, the parágrafo único's increase of one third. Pena re-written by Lei nº 10.763/2003 (13.11.2003): refused for an earlier fact; the definition answers for any date. Tests in cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4.

units.title: Descaminho
units.note: Caput and § 1º I-IV (with § 2º's equiparação of irregular trade), crime (consummated and attempted), pena (no fine), § 3º's doubling (reach F-g6a-17). Insignificância per STJ Tema 157 and the reiteração thesis (F-sweep-c-10, M-sweep-c-15/-16), the ceiling a parameter. Re-written whole by Lei nº 13.008/2014 (in force 27.6.2014): refused before. M-sweep-c-18 (Súmula 560) and M-sweep-c-24 (Súmula 151) no-effect; the absorption of an exhausted falsity (M-sweep-c-20, F-sweep-c-12) is g5's. Tests in cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4.

units.title: Contrabando
units.note: Caput and § 1º I-V (with § 2º), crime (consummated and attempted), pena (no fine), § 3º's doubling. Cigarette insignificância per STJ Tema 1143 (F-sweep-c-10, M-sweep-c-17). Added by Lei nº 13.008/2014; before it contraband was the old art. 334's, whose wording is not in the source, so an earlier fact is refused, not denied. Tests in cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4.

units.title: Impedimento, perturbação ou fraude de concorrência
units.note: Both limbs and the parágrafo único, crime ('procurar afastar' consummated, no reduction, F-g6a-18; the first limb attempted), pena with the violence's penalty besides. Encoded as printed; overlap with arts. 337-I and 337-K (g6b) is F-g6a-15. Tests in cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4.

units.title: Inutilização de edital ou de sinal
units.note: Both conducts, crime (consummated and attempted), pena ('ou multa'). Tests in cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4.

units.title: Subtração ou inutilização de livro ou documento
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena (no fine); subsidiarity as the judge's finding (F-g6a-10). Tests in cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4.

units.title: Sonegação de contribuição previdenciária
units.note: Caput I-III, crime (requiring the definitive constitution of the credit: M-sweep-c-23 / F-sweep-c-15), pena; § 1º extinction (declaration before the ação fiscal; same-day refused, F-g6a-08); §§ 5º-6º (LC nº 225/2026, in force 9.1.2026; acts from then on, F-g6a-19); Lei nº 10.684/2003 art. 9º (M-sweep-c-28, binding: parcelamento suspension, extinction by full payment, the persistent-debtor exclusion; F-g6a-20); § 2º's and § 3º's options for the judge, the administrative minimum and § 4º's readjusted ceiling as parameters (the readjusted value refused by name if asked of the encoding, F-g6a-21). Added by Lei nº 9.983/2000 (gate as art. 313-A). No attempt. Tests in cp-g6a-descaminho-a-sonegacao-testes.l4.

units.title: Corrupção ativa em transação comercial internacional
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, the parágrafo único's increase. The official moved must be a foreign public official under art. 337-D. Capítulo II-A added by Lei nº 10.467/2002 (in force 12.6.2002): not a crime before. Tests in cp-g6a-administracao-estrangeira-testes.l4.

units.title: Tráfico de influência em transação comercial internacional
units.note: Crime (consummated and attempted), pena, the parágrafo único's increase of one half. Added by Lei nº 10.467/2002. Tests in cp-g6a-administracao-estrangeira-testes.l4. [g6a corrected this unit's title: the enumeration had taken the line before the article, 'Pena – reclusão, de 1 (um) a 8 (oito) anos, e multa. (Incluído pela Lei nº 10.467, de 11.6.2002)'.]

units.title: Funcionário público estrangeiro
units.note: Caput and parágrafo único: `funcionário público estrangeiro (art. 337-D)`, exported, over a record of the facts declared in the module (only Capítulo II-A reads them). Tests in cp-g6a-administracao-estrangeira-testes.l4.
